notes:
CRM notes / call fragments and POC checklist:
- Company: Skyline Rift Analytics — mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics). Looking to add semantic search across product docs, changelogs and user tickets. Primary goal: reduce support deflection and improve in-app search relevance.
- Use-case details: embeddings + ANN index for semantic search; nightly batch ingestion of deltas (~5M small docs/month, avg 300 tokens) that must be embedded and upserted to vector DB. Real-time query load ~40-80 QPS peak, 99th latency target for query+NN lookup <150ms. Batch ingestion throughput target: be able to embed 200k docs/hour during off-peak window.
- Current prototype: Engineers built PoC with Hosted API + Pinecone. Works functionally but cost for sustained nightly batch is high and cold-start embedding latency inconsistent. They saw ~120ms per embedding call on Hosted (serial), parallelizing to 50ms avg at higher concurrency; priced out.
- Why Redwood: Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost (reserved GPU pool), and VPC connectivity to avoid egress to public vector DB. Also like Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to reduce token/unit cost.
- Technical wants: autoscaling for burst + guaranteed baseline for nightly jobs, KV/prefix caching for chat use-case in roadmap, function/structured outputs not required now. Must integrate with their vector store choice — options under evaluation: Weaviate (hosted), self-hosted Postgres+pgvector (managed by their infra), or hosted Pinecone variant. Need validation that Redwood Dedicated can stream embeddings in bulk and support efficient upserts to chosen vector DB.
- Security: Must support SSO (SAML), enterprise audit logs (90+ days), KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and EU data residency for a subset of datasets. Legal asks about retention controls and ability to isolate training signals — they will not allow datasets used for training outside their tenancy.
- POC plan (2 weeks):
  * Week 0 (prep): credentials, sample dataset (50k docs), Firestore export of product docs, set up test vector DB instance (pgvector) in their VPC subnet.
  * Week 1 (hosted): run Hosted API for query traffic simulation, measure embedding cost and query latency at 25/50/75 QPS; collect cost delta report.
  * Week 2 (dedicated): run a dedicated 3-GPU pool (trial) with autoscaling off for baseline numbers; run nightly batch of 200k embeddings/hour synthetic; measure token/unit cost, end-to-end batch time, and NN lookup latency.
  * Deliverable: short report with cost comparison, latency percentiles, recommended Dedicated sizing and draft reserved pricing.
- Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (Jordan Reed), Infra Lead (Leah Kim), CTO (Amit Sinha) — all engaged. Jordan emphasized: "We need predictable costs for monthly ingestion spikes; can't have 3x variance month-to-month."
- Pricing/Commercial: asked for 12-month reserved pricing scenarios (3-node vs 5-node pool) and burst credits. Sales to provide committed discount matrix.
- Integrations: ask for sample scripts for bulk embedding upload, and connector patterns for CDC pipelines (BigQuery -> embeddings -> vector upsert).
- Open questions / blockers:
  * Legal: data residency SLA language and support for EU-only storage for sensitive datasets.
  * Engineering: final decision on vector DB — pgvector preferred for control, but operations overhead. Need Redwood guidance on latency for pgvector vs hosted vector services when used with Dedicated.
  * Commercial: dedicated pricing for nightly batch heavy workloads — need modeled examples.
- Quick action items captured:
  1) AE Maya to schedule Dedicated pricing call (w/ pricing deck) — target 2024-12-06.
  2) SE Arjun to prepare 2 benchmark scripts for embedding throughput and NN latency and share repo link.
  3) Customer to provide sample 50k export by 2024-12-04.
  4) Legal to receive security FAQ doc and draft residency addendum (linked).
- Staging shorthand: in CRM say: "eval — hosted -> dedicated POC".
- Quote from Jordan on call 2024-11-27: "Can you show us a world where batch embedding costs are predictable and < $0.01/vector at our scale?"
- Internal note: potential anchor ARR if Dedicated ROI assumptions hold — separate upsell path for Optimize tooling.
